def solve_write_vec_orth(targets_dict, orth_unit_vec, bystander_weight=80.0, l2_reg=0.25):
    tids = list(targets_dict.keys())
    deltas = np.array([targets_dict[t][0] for t in tids], dtype=np.float32)
    ws     = np.array([targets_dict[t][1] for t in tids], dtype=np.float32)
    M_S = embed[tids] * scale_vec[None, :]
    A_mat = (M_S.T * ws[None, :]) @ M_S + bystander_weight * G_vocab + l2_reg * np.eye(D, dtype=np.float32) + 5000.0 * np.outer(orth_unit_vec, orth_unit_vec)
    b_vec = (M_S.T * ws[None, :]) @ deltas
    return np.linalg.solve(A_mat, b_vec).astype(np.float32)

def fit_smooth(X_tr, lb_tr, target_spec, reg_frac=0.35):
    keep = np.isin(lb_tr, list(target_spec.keys()))
    Xk, lbk = X_tr[keep], lb_tr[keep]
    y = np.array([target_spec[l][0] for l in lbk], dtype=np.float32)
    w = np.array([target_spec[l][1] for l in lbk], dtype=np.float32)
    sqw = np.sqrt(w)
    Xw, yw = Xk * sqw[:, None], y * sqw
    K = Xw @ Xw.T
    lam = reg_frac * np.trace(K) / len(Xk)
    a = Xw.T @ np.linalg.solve(K + lam * np.eye(len(Xk)), yw)
    prim = [k for k, v in target_spec.items() if v[0] >= 0.99][0]
    sc = float((X_tr[lb_tr == prim] @ a).mean())
    return (a / (sc + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
